name: Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited
summary: Bradaverse Education (Int'l) Investments Group Limited is an Admiralty-based investment holding company founded in 1997 that offers private education in Hong Kong. Beyond schooling it has segments in securities investment, lending and VR and digital entertainment. Its teaching covers primary and secondary tutoring, skills and test preparation, English, dance and STEAM courses sold under brands such as Modern Education. Until January 2023 it was named Hong Kong Education (Int'l) Investments Limited.
